item.title: Fast sync from Sentinel snapshots, and Sentry light clients
item.body:
A fresh node, a desktop wallet or a browser reaches a usable view of NoM in minutes
instead of hours to weeks, and a wallet can verify what it shows instead of trusting one
RPC endpoint (roadmap M8a and M11c).

- A deterministic state export with a manifest signed by a Sentinel's operator key
- Sentry S1, no fork: a light client that asks three or more Sentinels and names the one that lies
- Sentry S2, after finality: balances verified against the state root
